info.title: Portfolio Service API
info.description: Declarative Zod Validated & Programmatically Generated API Spec

get.description: Fetches a list of published case studies including title, slug, primary language, and tags.

post.summary: Submit draft technical post-mortem case study
post.description: Submits a new technical case study or prototype post-mortem as an unpublished draft record.

201.description: Case study submitted successfully in unpublished draft state

400.description: Missing or malformed payload fields or duplicate slug

get.description: Retrieves learning feedback for a case study slug.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Case study slug identifier (interchangeable with caseStudySlug)

parameters.name: caseStudySlug
parameters.description: Case study slug identifier (interchangeable with slug)

post.description: Validates and persists structured learning takeaways and free-form constructive text.

429.description: Rate limit or duplicate submission limit reached

get.description: Fetches aggregate quick reaction counts for a case study slug.

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: Case study slug identifier (interchangeable with caseStudySlug)

parameters.name: caseStudySlug
parameters.description: Case study slug identifier (interchangeable with slug)

post.description: Increments quick reaction badge count for a case study slug.

get.description: Perform dynamic grouping aggregates on TelemetryEvents to sum view & click metrics.

post.description: Buffers telemetry transaction events for asynchronous synchronization to the primary datastore. The Redis buffer is the only store in front of the sync job, so a failed enqueue drops the event: such a request is answered with 202 and durable=false rather than being reported as stored.

durable.description: Whether the event was accepted into the durable buffer. False means the event was dropped.

202.description: Event accepted but not durably buffered; the buffer write failed and the event was dropped. Clients must not retry.

durable.description: Whether the event was accepted into the durable buffer. False means the event was dropped.

get.summary: Run the unified daily maintenance pipeline
get.description: Authenticated Vercel Hobby cron route that drains telemetry and reaction buffers, processes a bounded email retry batch, and rolls raw telemetry older than 30 days into daily aggregates before pruning it. Returns isolated per-phase outcomes under an eight-second overall deadline.

parameters.name: batch
parameters.description: Maximum telemetry and reaction items to drain

200.description: Complete or partial execution summary with isolated phase counts, durations, and errors

get.description: Backward-compatible alias for the unified daily maintenance pass. Pulls buffered telemetry events from the secondary Redis cache and flushes them to the primary datastore in batches, then drains the case-study reaction write-buffer into Postgres.

parameters.name: batch
parameters.description: Batch parameters for loading buffered items

post.summary: Submit visitor contact and collaboration inquiry
post.description: Validates and processes inbound contact form submissions, evaluates spam protection gates, and dispatches notification emails.

400.description: Validation or tone policy violation on submission payload

post.summary: Subscribe email address to the systems engineering dispatch newsletter
post.description: Validates email address, verifies spam and duration gates, registers subscriber, and delivers a welcome confirmation receipt.

400.description: Invalid request payload or malformed email address

post.description: Cryptographically verifies Svix webhook signatures and processes email lifecycle events (bounces, complaints, delivery status) to maintain suppression lists.

400.description: Missing required Svix headers or invalid JSON payload

422.description: Payload does not match Resend webhook schema

get.description: Returns persisted unpublished BlogPost rows for authorized administrators only. Public fallback content is never used for this inventory.

500.description: Unable to load drafts from persistence

post.summary: Create an unpublished sanitized blog draft
post.description: Creates a persisted BlogPost in server-owned unpublished state for an authorized administrator. Publication, identity, and timestamp fields are rejected.

400.description: Invalid body, taxonomy, field bounds, or mass-assignment attempt

409.description: A draft with the slug already exists

get.description: Returns one persisted unpublished BlogPost row for an authorized administrator. Published records and public fallback content are not available through this endpoint.

patch.summary: Edit an unpublished sanitized blog draft
patch.description: Partially updates a persisted BlogPost only while it remains unpublished. Publication, identity, and timestamp fields are rejected, changed HTML is sanitized, and old and new slug caches are invalidated only after persistence succeeds.

400.description: Invalid body, empty edit, taxonomy, field bounds, or mass-assignment attempt

404.description: Unpublished draft not found or no longer editable after concurrent publication

409.description: A draft with the requested slug already exists

title.description: Title of the post-mortem or case study

primary_language.description: Primary programming language or tech stack

tags.description: Tags as comma-separated string or array of tag strings

windowMs.description: Sliding rate window duration in ms

maxRequests.description: Maximum requests allowed within the window

batch.description: Batch parameter size for loading buffered items

hasSubmitted.description: Indicates whether user with same connection hash has submitted feedback

userReactions.description: Reaction types submitted by current user connection hash
